incident_intake.expression: output.incident_id == input.incident_id && output.service == input.service && output.started_at == input.started_at && output.symptom == input.symptom && output.accepted
incident_intake.failure_reason: Incident Intake did not preserve the submitted incident

investigation_planner.failure_reason: Investigation Planner produced an incomplete investigation plan

log_analyzer.expression: output.service == input.service && output.error_code == input.logs[0].error_code && output.error_count == 2.0 && output.first_error_at == input.logs[0].timestamp
log_analyzer.failure_reason: Log Analyzer misread the service error records

metrics_analyzer.expression: output.observed_at == input.metrics.observed_at && output.p95_latency_ms == input.metrics.p95_latency_ms && output.threshold_ms == input.metrics.threshold_ms && output.error_rate == input.metrics.error_rate && output.state == (input.metrics.p95_latency_ms > input.metrics.threshold_ms ? "critical" : "normal")
metrics_analyzer.failure_reason: Metrics Analyzer misclassified the latency threshold breach

deployment_analyzer.expression: output.deployment_id == input.deployments[1].deployment_id && output.commit == input.deployments[1].commit && output.deployed_at == input.deployments[1].deployed_at && output.changed_field == "request_timeout_seconds" && output.before_value == input.deployments[1].timeout_before_seconds && output.after_value == input.deployments[1].timeout_after_seconds && output.correlated
deployment_analyzer.failure_reason: Deployment Analyzer selected the wrong deployment

runbook_loader.expression: output.runbook_id == input.runbook.runbook_id && output.signal == input.runbook.signal && output.cause == input.runbook.cause && output.recommended_action == input.runbook.recommended_action && output.loaded
runbook_loader.failure_reason: Runbook Loader did not load the supplied runbook

evidence_merger.expression: output.service == input.logs.service && output.error_code == input.logs.error_code && output.error_count == input.logs.error_count && output.first_error_at == input.logs.first_error_at && output.metric_state == input.metrics.state && output.p95_latency_ms == input.metrics.p95_latency_ms && output.threshold_ms == input.metrics.threshold_ms && output.metric_observed_at == input.metrics.observed_at && output.deployment_id == input.deployment.deployment_id && output.deployment_at == input.deployment.deployed_at && output.deployment_correlated == input.deployment.correlated
evidence_merger.failure_reason: Evidence Merger did not faithfully combine its actual inputs

timeline_builder.expression: output.deployment_id == input.deployment_id && output.deployment_at == input.deployment_at && output.first_error_at == input.first_error_at && output.metric_observed_at == input.metric_observed_at && output.ordered == (input.deployment_at < input.first_error_at && input.first_error_at < input.metric_observed_at)
timeline_builder.failure_reason: Timeline Builder ordered the evidence incorrectly

hypothesis_generator.expression: output.cause == (input.evidence.metric_state == "critical" && input.evidence.deployment_correlated && input.evidence.error_code == "REQUEST_TIMEOUT" ? "timeout_regression" : (input.evidence.metric_state != "critical" ? "application_error" : "traffic_spike")) && output.confidence == (input.evidence.metric_state == "critical" && input.evidence.deployment_correlated && input.evidence.error_code == "REQUEST_TIMEOUT" ? "high" : "medium")
hypothesis_generator.failure_reason: Hypothesis Generator produced a conclusion inconsistent with its actual evidence

impact_assessor.expression: output.severity == (input.hypothesis.confidence == "high" && input.evidence.error_count >= 2.0 ? "SEV1" : "SEV2") && output.affected_service == input.evidence.service && output.customer_impact == (input.hypothesis.confidence == "high" && input.evidence.error_count >= 2.0 ? "checkout requests are failing for customers" : "degraded checkout performance")
impact_assessor.failure_reason: Impact Assessor produced an impact inconsistent with the evidence

runbook_matcher.expression: output.runbook_id == input.runbook.runbook_id && output.applicable == (input.runbook.loaded && input.runbook.cause == input.hypothesis.cause) && output.action == (input.runbook.loaded && input.runbook.cause == input.hypothesis.cause ? input.runbook.recommended_action : "collect additional evidence")
runbook_matcher.failure_reason: Runbook Matcher selected an action inconsistent with the hypothesis

remediation_planner.expression: output.cause == input.hypothesis.cause && output.priority == input.impact.severity && output.action == input.runbook.action && output.owner == "checkout-on-call"
remediation_planner.failure_reason: Remediation Planner did not preserve its hypothesis, impact, and runbook inputs

incident_summary.expression: output.title == "Checkout API timeout incident" && output.root_cause == input.hypothesis.cause && output.severity == input.remediation.priority && output.resolution == input.remediation.action
incident_summary.failure_reason: Incident Summary did not represent the final investigation inputs
